checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 480x854 portrait, full-bleed art. Duration 8 s per the frame labels.

must.item: Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons move slowly on dark background
must.why: Frames show ribbons changing shape between times, soft blue/purple glow on near-black. Mid-clip is mostly purple, with less blue.

must.item: Top third mostly dark, brightest ribbons lower
must.why: The top third is clear in all frames. The ribbons sit in the middle, at about 40-75% height. The bright peak at 3.2 s reaches about 40%.

must.item: No visible jump at loop boundary
must.why: The 7.6 s frame closely matches the 0.8 s frame and the source still. This suggests a seamless loop, but the actual boundary was not seen.

must.item: No words, clock graphics or UI elements

must.why: Audio cannot be checked from still frames. The assistant said it turned sound off.

faults.what: Ribbons sit mid-frame rather than in the lower part. The 3.2 s frame has a bright glow near 40% height, close to the top third edge.
Low 480p resolution and slight softness or compression.
Only one main ribbon group, a little sparse. The blue content shifts to mostly purple mid-clip.

summary: A clean, dark, uncluttered vertical ribbon wallpaper with slow motion and a likely seamless loop. The ribbons sit mid-frame rather than low, and the resolution is only 480p.
